abstract: Serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme I catalytic concentration (S-LD-1) was measured in patients with testicular seminoma clinical stage I followed with surveillance after orchiectomy. The serum samples were obtained before orchiectomy in 110 patients (group A) and soon after orchiectomy in 55 patients (group B). In group A, 60 patients (55%) had elevated S-LD-1 and 10 patients (9%) had elevated serum human chorionic gonadotropin concentrations (S-hCG). In group B, median S-LD-1 was lower than that of group A and decreased with increasing time after orchiectomv (p = 0.001, Jonckheere-Terpstra test, one-sided). After a median follow-up of 5.1 years, 23 patients (21%) in group A had relapses. The patients with elevated S-LD-1 and those with normal S-LD-1 had a similar relapse-free survival (p = 0.79, log-rank test). Thus patients with seminoma stage I had elevated S-LD-1 more often than elevated S-hCG but an elevation in S-LD-1 did not predict a relapse during follow-up with surveillance. Further studies are required to elucidate the value of S-LD-1 in monitoring the surveillance of patients with seminoma stage I.
abstract_ja: 精巣摘除術後にサーベイランスを行った臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者において、血清乳酸脱水素酵素アイソザイムI(S-LD-1)の触媒濃度を測定した。精巣摘除術前の110例(A群)と、精巣摘除術直後の55例(B群)から血清検体を採取した。A群では60例(55%)でS-LD-1が上昇し、10例(9%)で血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン濃度(S-hCG)が上昇していた。B群では、S-LD-1の中央値はA群より低く、精巣摘除術後の経過時間とともに低下した(p = 0.001、Jonckheere-Terpstra検定、片側)。中央値5.1年のフォローアップ後、A群の23例(21%)で再発がみられた。S-LD-1が上昇した患者と正常な患者の無再発生存率は同程度であった(p = 0.79、log-rank検定)。したがって、病期Iのセミノーマ患者ではS-hCGの上昇よりもS-LD-1の上昇が多くみられたが、S-LD-1の上昇はサーベイランス中のフォローアップにおける再発を予測しなかった。S-LD-1のサーベイランスにおける価値を明らかにするには、さらなる研究が必要である。
